title: Operate the Worker fleet and recovery boundary
description: Select a production incident, then change Worker capacity and recovery controls. Watch queue pressure, detection time, side-effect safety, and deployment or history risk move independently.

incidents.label: Order traffic surge
incidents.detail: Activity Tasks arrive faster while payment latency remains normal.
response: Confirm pollers and schedule-to-start latency before changing retry policy.
Scale capable Workers or remove the slow downstream bottleneck.
Protect the dependency with concurrency limits while backlog drains.
Verify end-to-end order age, not only task throughput.

incidents.label: Long export Worker crashes
incidents.detail: A multi-minute export loses its Worker after completing 68% of the input.
response: Use Heartbeat Timeout to detect missing progress before Start-to-Close expires.
Resume from heartbeat details only after validating the checkpoint.
Keep export writes idempotent because another attempt can repeat a page.
Test cancellation delivery and cleanup through the Activity heartbeat path.

incidents.label: Workflow release changes commands
incidents.detail: Version 2 Workers are ready while version 1 histories are still open.
response: Replay representative version 1 histories with version 2 code.
Ramp a versioned Worker Deployment instead of mixing incompatible code.
Keep pinned executions on a compatible version until they complete or migrate.
Alert on non-determinism and Workflow Task failure before retiring version 1.

incidents.label: Signal-heavy entity keeps growing
incidents.detail: A long-lived account Workflow receives frequent Signals and Activities.
response: Track history length and size before the internal run budget is exhausted.
Wait for Signal and Update handlers to finish before Continue-As-New.
Pass forward compact durable state, not the old Event History.
Verify Child Workflow and Parent Close Policy behavior across the handoff.
